name: IB Chemistry Prep: Reagmere
subtitle: IB Chemistry SL/HL labs, mocks
shortDescription: IB Chemistry practice that adapts to you: adaptive quizzes, 10 labs, guided builds and mock papers for SL and HL. Works offline. No account.
longDescription:
IB Chemistry Prep: Reagmere is a revision companion for IB Chemistry at standard and higher level. It follows the current course topics, Structure and Reactivity, with HL extensions clearly marked.

### Learn Your Way
- Syllabus view in classical order, or Real-World view with guided builds
- Lessons with worked examples, common mistakes and real-world hooks
- Original questions: multiple choice, calculations, short answer and explain, each with marking-style feedback
- Adaptive plan: wrong answers lead to the idea to revise, and the app explains why each step is next

### Practise Like the Exam
- Quizzes by topic, by command term or by your gaps
- Timed mock papers in the style of Paper 1A, Paper 1B and Paper 2 with a report and study plan
- Command term trainer and an internal assessment coach with an uncertainty tool

### Labs and Builds
- Ten interactive simulations: moles, gas laws, molecular shapes, equilibrium, emission spectra, energy cycles, collision theory, pH and titration curves, voltaic cells and curly-arrow mechanisms
- Four guided builds: check the acid in vinegar, compare a fuel, plan an ester synthesis, identify an unknown from its data

### Made for Every Screen
- Text size from 50% to 300%, phone and tablet layouts, works offline
- A Coverage screen showing exactly what is included, and an Other boards map to GCSE, A Level and AP equivalents
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
